```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,sf,lwgeom,terra,tmap,httr,
               rvest,lubridate,spatstat.geom,spatstat.explore,stpp)
```

```{r}

folder_path <- "data/aspatial"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA*.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```

```{r}
summary(acra_data
        )
```
